rule: Every contact below was read from the cached official page named in `source` (data/raw/). Numbers found only in news/secondary sources are excluded.

contacts.label: Police (emergency)
contacts.when: Immediate danger, illegal lock-out with no shelter, threats or violence

contacts.label: Dubai Police - Al Ameen service
contacts.quote: Dubai Police through their Al Ameen service by calling on 8004444 from within the UAE

contacts.label: Rental Disputes Center (RDC)
contacts.when: Filing or asking about a rental dispute, urgent/interim relief
contacts.quote: You can reach us via phone on the below number +971 - 8004484

contacts.label: Dubai Land Department call centre
contacts.when: Ejari, Rental Index and general DLD services
contacts.quote: Just give us a call at this number +971 - 8004488

excluded.reason: Widely reported as Dubai Police non-emergency line, but the cached u.ae page attributes 901 to Sharjah Police (Najeed); not attributable to Dubai Police from an official cached source.

note: The RDC and DLD official pages list different numbers (8004484 vs 8004488); both are shown with their own source.
